verdict.rationale: A tax agency's digital services could plausibly expose versioned APIs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents only web-portal features (Online Services, Web File, Quick Pay). There are no API docs, no versioning scheme and no deprecation policy, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returned 404. The mention of approved third-party tax software is an adjacent channel, not a documented versioned API with a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
